from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Ai_Review(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_ai_review"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("plan",             "any")
        self.add_input("plan_json",        "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("execution_result", "any")
        self.add_input("result_json",      "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_output("outcome",         "string")
        self.add_output("match_score",     "float")
        self.add_output("findings",        "list")
        self.add_output("recommendations", "list")
        self.add_output("op_stats",        "any")
        self.add_output("explanation",     "string")
        self.add_output("review_json",     "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        from src.runtime.execution_review import get_execution_reviewer
        from src.runtime.execution_explainer import get_execution_explainer
        from src.runtime.planning_memory import get_planning_memory

        _empty = {
            "exec_out": True, "outcome": "undetermined", "match_score": 0.0,
            "findings": [], "recommendations": [],
            "op_stats": {}, "explanation": "", "review_json": "{}"
        }

        # Resolve plan
        plan = inputs.get("plan")
        if not plan:
            raw = inputs.get("plan_json") or ""
            if raw:
                try:
                    plan = json.loads(raw)
                except Exception as exc:
                    _empty["findings"] = [f"plan_json parse error: {exc}"]
                    return _empty
        if not plan or not isinstance(plan, dict):
            _empty["findings"] = ["No plan provided — review will have no context."]
            plan = {}

        # Resolve execution result
        exec_result = inputs.get("execution_result")
        if not exec_result:
            raw = inputs.get("result_json") or ""
            if raw:
                try:
                    exec_result = json.loads(raw)
                except Exception as exc:
                    _empty["findings"] = [f"result_json parse error: {exc}"]
                    return _empty
        if not exec_result or not isinstance(exec_result, dict):
            _empty["findings"] = ["No execution_result provided."]
            return _empty

        try:
            reviewer = get_execution_reviewer()
            review = reviewer.review(plan, exec_result)

            explainer = get_execution_explainer()
            expl = explainer.explain_review(review)

            # Record in planning memory
            try:
                mem = get_planning_memory()
                mem.record("review_result", {
                    "intent":     plan.get("intent", ""),
                    "plan_id":    plan.get("plan_id", ""),
                    "outcome":    review.get("outcome", "undetermined"),
                    "match_score": review.get("intent_match_score", 0.0),
                    "findings":   review.get("findings", []),
                })
            except Exception:
                pass

            review_json = json.dumps(review, default=str)

        except Exception as exc:
            _empty["findings"] = [f"review error: {exc}"]
            return _empty

        return {
            "exec_out":       True,
            "outcome":        review.get("outcome", "undetermined"),
            "match_score":    float(review.get("intent_match_score", 0.0)),
            "findings":       review.get("findings", []),
            "recommendations":review.get("recommendations", []),
            "op_stats":       review.get("op_stats", {}),
            "explanation":    expl.get("full_text", ""),
            "review_json":    review_json,
        }

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Ai_Review
